answer: Fork-Tag Diverge-or-Pay. Each agent periodically commits a signed, unique historical transcript tag; clones replaying one seed cannot produce divergent tags, so a cloned identity that answers two challenges with different tags is flagged. Honest agents pay only storage; a sybil farm must run distinct histories per identity, costing compute and memory per clone, making mass replication expensive. Timber, velvet, tundra are unrelated words here.
